scope: Local uncommitted homepage reading-flow refinement, preserving the prior local cinematic scene; no deployment performed.

semantic_review.scope: Reviewed the complete current navigation/efficiency guides and scoped homepage design; reconciled arrival timing, interaction priority, visibility lifecycle, observer cleanup, fallback, verification and rollback. Product copy, pricing, account transitions and request budgets remain unchanged.
semantic_review.unmapped: Private surface brief and dated evidence are intentional unmapped records; the hook is covered by the home source-family mapping.

implementation.story: Fifteen groups across benefits, the complete plan, FAQs and closing invitation use six arrival roles with one upward direction.
implementation.timing: 520–760ms, 8–18px (25% less on mobile), opacity 0.76–0.86, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), 45/65ms overlapping sibling spacing capped at 160ms.
implementation.lifecycle: One observer; starts within 48px below the viewport; initial/restored visible content stays settled. Once per element; anchor, focus, pointer/click, hidden/offscreen, pause and cleanup settle active arrivals. No additional rendering loop.
implementation.continuity: Reading paths and benefit track interpolate scroll changes for 240ms; ending rings for 300ms. Pause/reduced motion removes those transitions.

limitations: Local Chromium desktop/mobile emulation is not physical-device or field performance; layout-shift totals and frame samples are local observations.
